statement: 90 of 1670 legs in the 2026-11-27 snapshot are priced against a NAV that is not that session's (lag up to 9 trading day(s)); over this repo's snapshot history only 99.0% of rows are same-day. 46 are one-offs (their own history lands same-day on >= 85% of snapshots, so a later pass fixes them); 42 sit at 70-85% -- on most days that field is an intraday estimate, and today it fell back to yesterday's official NAV; the row cannot tell you which one it is holding; 2 rarely land same-day at all. On 89 of them the printed premium moved exactly as the price did since the previous snapshot, which is what an unchanged denominator forces -- those readings carry no premium information at all. Largest printed premiums among them: 159509 纳指科技 44.3%, 159501 纳指基金 22.8%, 159696 纳100ETF 22.7%, 159659 纳指 20.6%, 513870 纳指ETF富国 20.5%.
notes: premium_rebanded is (1+printed)/(1+r) over that leg's own official NAV daily returns; it is an interval for a number that has not been published yet, not a better estimate of it.

identity_price_is_the_whole_story tests the exact relation (1+prem_T)/(1+prem_T-1) == P_T/P_T-1, which holds only while the denominator is unchanged; when it is true the printed premium change carries no premium information at all.

same_day_share is over the snapshots this repo captured for that leg, not over the vendor's whole publication history; with a dozen snapshots the lines at 85% and 70% describe the two groups that exist on the board, they are not a statistical test.
